"The shelter view is more of an overhead top down view, and the main character's actions and movement are controlled by the player. The main characters main actions are restoring the shelter to make it stronger to withstand attacks, while repairing the shelter areas that get damaged by the creatures. The main character does have a weapon, but the resources it uses to repair and strengthen the shelter are either dropped by the creatures or found outside the shelter.
